I hope I didn’t fuck up and this guy doesn’t know my location and other data.
@Ew, he’s a weirdo. Great. How the hell did he find me? Fucking fossil, spamming this old ass :) emote.
Well, it seems I’m safe for now, but HOLY SHIT 10K! This guy must be joking. 
But if he’s not joking then… 
That amount of money would solve all my problems and it would allow me to… even go to college! 
Still, he might be just bullshitting me. Maybe it’s a setup! Like hell someone would offer 10k for a sexbot.
Should I just ignore him or accept his offer?
